units.slavonic_incipit: къ св. престолу, вынимаетъ чашу изъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: к св престолу вынимает чашу из кивота выбирает
units.slavonic_text: къ св. престолу, вынимаетъ чашу изъ кивота, выбираетъ св. Агнецъ, полагаетъ его на дискосъ, покрыетъ звѣздою и покровцемъ и покадивъ, несетъ къ жертовнику предходящимъ свѣщеносцамъ. Здѣсь въ чашу лѣетъ вино и воду глаголя: „Господу помолимся“. И по семъ пріуготовивъ все, возвратится къ св. Престолу, и здѣсь на „Слава и Нынѣ“ чинитъ входъ съ кадиломъ, (нѣкогда же и съ Евангеліемъ) и передъ царскими дверми возглашаетъ: „Премудрость прости“. По „Свѣте тихій“ и по „Вонмимъ, миръ всѣмъ, премудрость вонмимъ“ поется 1-ый прокименъ и бываетъ чтеніе изъ книги Бытія. По окончаніи сего чтенія ликъ сейчась поетъ 2-ый прокименъ, подъ которымъ Іерей приходитъ къ св. престолу, и когда пѣвецъ возглашаетъ „Повелите“, Іерей съ свѣщею трираменною и съ кадиломъ взирая на Востокъ глаголетъ: „Премудрость прости“ и къ народу обратившеся глаголетъ: „Свѣтъ Христовъ просвѣщаетъ всѣхъ“. На сіе чтецъ абіе начинаетъ 2-ое чтеніе глаголя: „Притчей чтеніе“, на что Іерей возглашаетъ: „Вонмимъ“ и чтецъ начинаетъ читати 2-ую парамію. Послѣ параміяхъ поется: „Да исправится молитва“, подъ которымъ пѣніемъ, когда на скоро поется стихъ „Да исправится“ Іерей стоитъ, когда же по малу поются стихи „Да исправится“, „Господи воззвахъ“, „Положи Господи храненіе“ и „Не оуклони сердца“, Іерей на колѣна припадаетъ. По окончаніи сего пѣнія 3 поклоны. (По семъ нѣкогда слѣдуетъ еще и прокименъ, Апостолъ и Евангеліе сирѣчь тогда, если празднуется нѣкій Святый полуелейный.) По Евангеліи, если есть, если же нѣтъ, то по пѣніи: „Да исправится“ поется ектенія: „Рцемъ вси“, и такъ отправляется Литургія Преждеосвященныхъ Даровъ, якъ то Литургиконъ показуетъ, о нейже слово будетъ въ ІІ. отдѣлѣ. (Изъ сей Вечерни таже не берется лишь половина и то до парамеевъ.)

Прежде входа Іерей не токмо въ епитрахиль и фелонъ, но и въ стихарь облекается и такъ творитъ входъ съ кадилницею и съ Евангеліемъ. units.english_text: This Vespers is great with an entrance, with the Gospel, and with the great dismissal. It is renowned also for this reason, that it hath a procession around the church with the Shroud (*Plashchanytsia*). The Priest beginneth it as usual in a black epitrachelion and concludeth it in due order. The usual beginning. No kathisma. Stichera on 6. Before the entrance the Priest vesteth not only in the epitrachelion and phelonion, but also in the sticharion, and thus maketh the entrance with the censer and with the Gospel. After “Gladsome Light” the Priest proclaimeth: “Let us attend! Peace be to all! Wisdom, let us attend!” and the prokimenon is sung. After the prokimenon, 1 paremia, and again one prokimenon, and thus 2 paremias. After the paremias immediately: “Let us attend! Peace be to all!” and the prokimenon is sung, and the Epistle is read: to the Corinthians, pericope 125 [1 Cor. 1:18–2:2]. After the Epistle the Priest proclaimeth: “Peace be to thee,” whereunto the choir singeth: “Alleluia” (thrice), and the Priest readeth the Gospel from Matthew, pericope 110 [Matt. 27:1–38; Luke 23:39–43; Matt. 27:39–54; John 19:31–37; Matt. 27:55–61]. After this, the litany: “Let us all say.” “Vouchsafe, O Lord” is read, and the litany is sung: “Let us complete our evening prayer,” etc. Aposticha stichera. When the choir saith: “Now lettest Thou,” the Priest spreadeth out the Shroud (*Plashchanytsia*) upon the holy table and censeth It. Thereafter, when the choir, upon the conclusion of “Now lettest Thou,” the Trisagion, and “Our Father,” beginneth to sing: “The noble Joseph,” the Priest placeth the Shroud upon his shoulders, and holding It with both hands upon his head, while other two men hold the other end of the Shroud, that is to say, from the feet, and thus the Priest, with the deacon censing and candle-bearers preceding, maketh the procession around the church, and that only once. At the procession Gospels also are read from all four Evangelists, namely: 1. Gospel from Matthew, pericope 113 (“Now when the even was come... over against the sepulchre” [Matt. 27:57–61]). 2. Gospel from Mark, pericope 66 (“Joseph came... where He was laid” [Mark 15:42–47]). 3. Gospel from Luke, pericope 111 (“And a man... rested according to the commandment” [Luke 23:50–56]). 4. Gospel from John, pericope 62 (“At that time... laid they Jesus” [John 19:38–42]). Having returned into the church, the Priest layeth the Shroud into the tomb, or upon another prepared place, and censeth It. And the cantor singeth at “Glory,” and “Now and”: “Unto the Myrrh-bearing Women.” After this, having put off the phelonion, he goeth unto the pulpit and delivereth the holy sermon. And after the sermon with genuflection he saith the prayer prescribed in the Trebnik. After the prayer, the great dismissal, namely: “Wisdom”; the choir: “Bless.” The Priest: “Blessed and glorified is...” After the blessing there taketh place the kissing of the Shroud with prostrations.

units.slavonic_text: прокименъ и такъ 2 парамеи. По парамеяхъ абіе „Вонмимъ, миръ всѣмъ“, и поется прокименъ, и чтется Апостолъ къ Кор. зач. 125. По Апостолѣ Іерей возглашаетъ: „Миръ ти“, на что ликъ поетъ: „Аллилуя 3“, Іерей же чтетъ Евангеліе отъ Матѳ. зач. 110. По семъ ектенія: „Рцемъ вси“. „Сподоби Господи“ чтется и поется ектенія: „Исполнимъ вечернія“ и пр. стихиры на стиховнахъ. Когда ликъ глаголетъ: „Нынѣ отпущаеши“, Іерей на св. престолѣ распростираетъ „плащаницу“, и покадитъ ю. Потомъ же, когда ликъ по окончанію „Нынѣ отпущаеши“, Трисвятомъ и Отче нашъ начнетъ пѣти: „Благообразный Іосифъ“, Іерей плащаницу возлагаетъ на плещи, и обоима руками на главѣ придерживше ю, другій же конецъ плащаницы сирѣчь отъ ногъ другіи два люди держатъ, а тако Іерей діакономъ кадящимъ и предидущимъ свѣщеносцамъ творитъ обхожденіе около церкви, и то только одинъ разъ. На обходѣ и Евангеліа чтѹтся отъ всѣхъ четырехъ Евангелистъ, и то: 1. Евангеліе отъ Матѳ. зач. 113. („Поздѣ бывшу... прямо гроба“.) 2. Евангеліе отъ Марка зач. 66. (Прійде Іосифъ... гдѣ его полагаху“.) 3. Еванг. отъ Луки зач. 111. („И мужъ... оумолчаша по за заповѣди“.) 4. Еванг. отъ Іоанна зач. 62. („Въ время оно... положиста Іисуса“.) Возвратившеся Іерей въ церковь полагаетъ плащаницу въ гробъ, или на иное пріуготовленное мѣсто и кадитъ ю. Пѣвецъ же поетъ на Слава и Нынѣ: „Мироносицамъ женамъ“. По семъ низложивше фелонъ, идетъ на казательницу и держитъ св. проповѣдь. По проповѣди же съ колѣнопреклоненіемъ глаголетъ молитву въ Требникѣ предписанную. По молитвѣ отпустъ великій, сир. „Премудрость“, ликъ: „Благослови“. Іерей: „Сый благословенъ и препрославленъ...“ По благословеніи бываетъ цѣлованіе плащаницы съ поклонами.

units.slavonic_text: Чинъ Вечерни Великой съ Литургіею св. Василія и съ благословеніемъ хлѣбовъ въ св. великую Субботу.
units.english_text: It beginneth at the 9th hour. The Priest, having come into the church, as usual as before the Divine Liturgy concludeth the prayers before the icons of the Savior and the Mother of God. After this, having entered into the holy sanctuary, he vesteth in all the priestly vestments, and those black, saying the prescribed prayers, and having washed his hands goeth unto the holy table and beginneth quietly: “Blessed is our God. Heavenly King. Glory to God in the highest” (twice), and “O Lord, open Thou my lips,” etc. (once). After this he proclaimeth: “Blessed is the kingdom,” the choir: “Amen.” And immediately the cantor: “Come, let us worship” (thrice), Psalm: “Bless the Lord, O my soul,” “Alleluia” (thrice); during the singing the Priest readeth the evening prayers, and after “Alleluia (thrice), Glory to Thee, O God,” the litany of peace. After the Exclamation the choir singeth: “Lord, I have cried” with the stichera on 8. And the Priest departeth to celebrate the proskomedia. When “Glory,” and “Now and” approacheth, the proskomedia must be concluded; during “Glory,” and “Now and” the entrance taketh place with the censer and the Gospel. The Priest: “Wisdom! Stand upright!” the choir: “Gladsome Light,” etc.; the prokimenon is not said, but 6 readings follow. And immediately the Priest at each one proclaimeth: “Wisdom!” the choir: “The reading from Genesis”; thereafter “The reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah”; further “The reading from Exodus,” “The reading from the Prophecy of Jonah,” “The reading from Joshua,” “The reading from Exodus.” This 6th reading the reader concludeth with the words: “Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spoke, saying,” whereunto the reader in Tone 5 beginneth to lead the chanting of the following verse: “Let us sing unto the Lord, for gloriously hath He been glorified.” The reader: “Glory,” and “Now and.” The choir: “Let us sing unto the Lord.” And again the reader concludeth: “Let us sing unto the Lord,” etc. After this follow 9 readings. And that: the Priest: “Wisdom!” the reader: “The reading from the Prophecy of Zephaniah,” “The reading from the Third Book of Kings,” “The reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah,” “The reading from Genesis,” “The reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah,” “The reading from the Sixth Book of Kings,” “The reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah,” “The reading from the Prophecy of Jeremiah,” “The reading from the Prophecy of Daniel.” And immediately the reader subjoineth the prayer or Song of the Three Holy Children: “Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers, and praised...” etc. At the very end of this the reader singeth the verse: “Praise the Lord and exalt Him above all forever,” and the choir singeth it twice. And immediately the reader chanteth the verses: “Bless the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the Lord, we praise,” and the choir after each verse answereth: “Praise the Lord and exalt Him above all forever.” At the end the reader: “Glory... and now and ever, and unto the ages of ages. Amen”; the choir: “Praise the Lord and exalt Him,” etc. The reader: “Praise the Lord and exalt Him,” etc. After this followeth the little litany with the Exclamation. During this singing the Priest from the high place entereth unto the Holy Table and here quietly saith the prayer prescribed in the Liturgikon before the Trisagion, and proclaimeth: “For holy art Thou,” etc. Instead of the Trisagion: “All of you that have been baptized into Christ.” Afterwards the Priest: “Let us attend! Peace be to all! Wisdom, let us attend!” and the choir the prokimenon: “Let all the earth worship Thee,” etc. The Epistle (to the Romans, pericope 91 [Rom. 6:3–11]). After this the Priest: “Peace be to thee! Wisdom, let us attend!” whereunto the choir instead of the Alleluia[^97] saith: “Arise, O God, judge the earth, for Thou shalt inherit among all the nations” [Ps. 81:8] multiple times in Tone 7. During that time the Priest changeth the black vestments into bright ones, and there followeth the Gospel from Matthew, pericope 115 [Matt. 28:1–20]. After this everything followeth in the order of the Divine Liturgy of St. Basil the Great. Instead of the Cherubic Hymn there is sung: “Let all mortal flesh keep silence,” and at the “Especially”: “Weep not for Me, O Mother”; the Communion Hymn: “The Lord awoke as one out of sleep, and is risen, saving us. Alleluia.” After the Divine Liturgy there is performed the blessing of loaves, wheat, wine, and oil, as at a Litiya. That is to say, after the Ambo Prayer the Priest cometh into the midst of the church, and having taken his stand there before the tetrapod proclaimeth: “Let us pray unto the Lord,” and loudly reciteth the prayer: “O Lord Jesus Christ our God, Who didst bless the five loaves,” etc.; after the prayer he censeth, and upon the conclusion of the singing of “Blessed be the name of the Lord” maketh the dismissal.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: вместо аллилуя глаголет воскресни боже суди земли яко
units.slavonic_text: вмѣсто Аллилуя*) глаголетъ: „Воскресни Боже, суди земли, яко ты наслѣдиши во всѣхъ языцѣхъ“ больше разъ на гласъ 7-ый. Подъ тѣмъ временемъ Іерей перемѣняетъ черныя одежды въ свѣтлыя и слѣдуетъ Евангеліе отъ Матѳ. зач. 115. По семъ все по ряду св. Литургіи св. Вас. Вел. слѣдуетъ. Вмѣсто пѣсни Херувимской поется: „Да оумолчитъ всяка плотъ“, на „Изрядно“ же „Не рыдай мене мати“, причастенъ: „Воста, яко спя Господь, и воскресе спасай насъ. Аллилуа“. Послѣ св. Литургіи совершается благословеніе хлѣбовъ, пшеницы, вина и елея, какъ на Литіи. Сирѣчь по молитвѣ заамвонной приходитъ Іерей на средину церкви, и тѣй ставъ передъ тетраподомъ возглашаетъ: „Господу помолимся“ и велегласитъ молитву: „Господи Іисусе Христе Боже нашъ, благословивый пять хлѣбовъ“ и пр., по молитвѣ покадитъ, и по скончаніи пѣнія „Буди имя“ творитъ отпустъ.

units.slavonic_incipit: Христе Спасе“ и пр., Іерей же
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: христе спасе и пр иерей же абие взем
units.slavonic_text: Христе Спасе“ и пр., Іерей же абіе вземъ евангеліе и крестъ, выходитъ на амвонъ и поетъ: „Да воскреснетъ Богъ“ и прочіи стихи. На сіе ликъ по каждомъ стихѣ поетъ стихиры Пасцѣ: „Пасха священная“ и проч., окончитъ же съ „Христосъ воскресе“ трижды. Подъ пѣніемъ людіе цѣлуютъ крестъ, евангеліе и образъ воскресшаго Христа. Такожде тогда бываетъ и мированіе и раздается благословенный хлѣбъ, или такъ названный антидоръ. По томъ бываетъ отпустъ великій, сирѣчь: „Премудрость“, „Благослови“ и пр. „Христосъ воскресый изъ мертвыхъ смертію смерть поправый и сущымъ въ гробѣ животъ даровавый истинный Богъ нашъ“ и пр. какъ въ Молитвословѣ стр. 478. По отпустѣ Іерей обращся къ людемъ съ крестомъ глаголетъ 3-жды: „Христосъ воскресе“, а людіе отвѣчаютъ: „Воистинну воскресе“. Благословеніе. И такъ творитъ Вечерню черезъ цѣлую свѣтлую седмицу. Въ Свѣтлой Седмицѣ всякое благословеніе съ Крестомъ бываетъ.
units.english_text: O Christ Savior,” etc.; and the Priest immediately, having taken the Gospel and the Cross, cometh forth onto the ambo and singeth: “Let God arise” and the other verses. Unto this the choir after each verse singeth the Paschal stichera: “A sacred Pascha,” etc., and concludeth with “Christ is risen” thrice. During the singing the people kiss the Cross, the Gospel, and the icon of the risen Christ. Likewise at that time the myrovania taketh place and the blessed bread, or so-called antidoron, is distributed. After that the great dismissal taketh place, that is to say: “Wisdom,” “Bless,” etc., “Christ is risen from the dead, trampling down death by death, and unto those in the tombs bestowing life, our true God,” etc., as in the Molitvoslov, p. 478. After the dismissal the Priest, having turned unto the people with the Cross, saith thrice: “Christ is risen!” and the people answer: “Truly He is risen!” Blessing. And thus he celebrateth Vespers throughout the entire Bright Week. In Bright Week every blessing taketh place with the Cross.

units.slavonic_text: β) Чинъ Вечерни въ свѣтлой седмицѣ, если случится въ нѣкій день Святый полуелейный. — Іерей одѣявъ вси одежды и покадивъ церковь, предъ св. Трапезою начинаетъ отъ: „Благословенъ Богъ нашъ“. По семъ: „Христосъ воскресе“ 3-жды съ стихами. На конецъ Іерей поетъ: „Христосъ воскресе“ разъ, ликъ же дваразъ. И абіе ектенія мирная. (Кадизмы нѣтъ въ свѣтлой седмицѣ.) На „Господи воззвахъ“ стихиры 6, и то 3 Воскресенію, а 3 Святому. Слава: Святаго, И нынѣ: Богородиченъ догматъ, т. е. первый гласа. Входъ съ кадиломъ. Прокименъ дню. Чтенія Святаго. На стиховнѣхъ стихира одна воскресна, прочіи же стихиры Пасцѣ. (Цѣлованіе креста.) Слава: Святаго, И нынѣ: „Воскресенія день“ и пр. „Христосъ воскресе“ 3-жды. И абіе Слава: Тропарь Святому, И нынѣ: Богородиченъ по гласу Святаго. Отпустъ Пасхи съ Крестомъ. Благословеніе съ Крестомъ черезъ цѣлую Седмицу.
units.english_text: (β) Order of Vespers in Bright Week, if on a certain day a polyeleos Saint should occur. — The Priest, having put on all the vestments and censed the church, before the Holy Table beginneth from: “Blessed is our God.” After this: “Christ is risen” thrice with the verses. At the end the Priest singeth: “Christ is risen” once, and the choir twice. And immediately the litany of peace. (There is no kathisma in Bright Week.) At “Lord, I have cried,” 6 stichera, namely 3 of the Resurrection, and 3 unto the Saint. “Glory,” of the Saint; “Now and,” Theotokion-dogmaticon, that is, the first of the tone. Entrance with the censer. Prokimenon of the day. Readings of the Saint. At the aposticha, one sticheron of the Resurrection, and the rest the stichera of Pascha. (Veneration of the Cross.) “Glory,” of the Saint; “Now and,” “The Day of Resurrection,” etc., “Christ is risen” thrice. And immediately “Glory,” Troparion unto the Saint; “Now and,” Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint. Paschal dismissal with the Cross. Blessing with the Cross throughout the entire week.

units.slavonic_incipit: Примѣчаніе. Что касается вечерней отъ Недѣли
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: примечание что касается вечерней от недели фоминой до
units.slavonic_text: Примѣчаніе. Что касается вечерней отъ Недѣли Ѳоминой до Вознесенія, о сихъ слѣдующія потребно замѣтити: α) Вечерня недѣльная поемая въ Субботу вечеръ, чинится сице: По „Благословенъ Богъ нашъ“ Іерей поетъ „Христосъ воскресе“ разъ, а пѣвецъ два разъ. (Стихи не поются.) И абіе Трисвятое.*) Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. Господи пом. 12. Прійдите покл. 3. Псаломъ предначинательный: „Благослови душе моя“. Ектенія мирная. Кадизма. На „Господи воззвахъ“ стихиры 10.**) Входъ великій.
units.english_text: Note. Concerning Vespers from Thomas Sunday until Ascension, it is necessary to note the following regarding these: (α) Sunday Vespers, sung on Saturday evening, is celebrated thus: After “Blessed is our God” the Priest singeth “Christ is risen” once, and the cantor twice. (The verses are not sung.) And immediately the Trisagion.[^98] “Our Father” with the Exclamation. “Lord, have mercy” (12 times). “Come, let us worship” (thrice). The Introductory Psalm: “Bless the Lord, O my soul.” Litany of peace. Kathisma. At “Lord, I have cried,” 10 stichera.[^99] Great entrance.

units.slavonic_text: Єктеніи 2. На стиховнѣхъ одна стихира воскресна по ряду изъ Тріоди цвѣтной, и абіе поются стихиры Пасцѣ (изнявше Недѣлю Ѳомину) „Да воскреснетъ Богъ“ и пр. „Пасха священная“ и пр. Слава: Святаго, если есть; И нынѣ: „Воскресенія день“, и одинъ разъ: „Христосъ воскресе“ и такъ „Нынѣ отпущаеши“. (Когда поются стихиры Пасцѣ, Іерей растворяетъ царскія двери, выходитъ на амвонъ и даетъ людямъ крестъ цѣловати.) По „Нынѣ отпущаеши“ поются тропари и абіе отпустъ Пасхи съ Крестомъ. — β) О повседневной Вечерни то потребно замѣтити, что сей Вечерни начало есть такое, какъ и недѣльной. Она отправляется порядочно. По ектеніи кадизма дню, Стихиры на „Господи воззвахъ“ 6, и то и Святому. Входа нѣтъ. Стихиры на стиховнѣхъ воскресны изъ Тріоди Цвѣтной (а не Пасцѣ.) Слава: Святому, И нынѣ: Богородиченъ. По „Нынѣ отпущаеши“ вся порядочно. (Стихиры Пасцѣ на повседневной Вечерни лишь въ Вторникъ вечеръ на отданіе праздника Пасхи берутся.) Отпустъ безъ Креста, т. е. At the aposticha, one sticheron of the Resurrection in order from the Flowery Triodion, and immediately the stichera of Pascha are sung (except on Thomas Sunday): “Let God arise,” etc., “A sacred Pascha,” etc. “Glory,” of the Saint, if there be one; “Now and,” “The Day of Resurrection,” and once: “Christ is risen”; and thus “Now Thou lettest depart.” (When the stichera of Pascha are sung, the Priest openeth the royal doors, cometh forth onto the ambo, and giveth the Cross unto the people to kiss.) After “Now Thou lettest depart” the troparia are sung and immediately the dismissal of Pascha with the Cross. — (β) Concerning daily Vespers, it is necessary to note that the beginning of this Vespers is the same as that of Sunday Vespers. It is celebrated in order. After the litany, the kathisma of the day; the stichera at “Lord, I have cried” on 6, and that also unto the Saint. There is no entrance. The stichera at the aposticha are of the Resurrection from the Flowery Triodion (and not of Pascha). “Glory,” unto the Saint; “Now and,” Theotokion. After “Now Thou lettest depart,” all in order. (The stichera of Pascha at daily Vespers are taken only on Tuesday evening at the Apodosis of the Feast of Pascha.) The dismissal is without the Cross, that is to say: “Wisdom”; “He Who rose from the dead,” etc.

units.slavonic_text: Вечерня сія въ Недѣлю Сош. св. Духа абіе отправляется по св. Литургіи и то совокупно съ колѣнопреклонными молитвами ради призыванія св. Духа. Чинъ сей Вечерни есть слѣдующій. По „Буди имя Господне“ Іерей вшедъ въ св. олтарь, начинаетъ: „Благословенъ Богъ нашъ“ и пр. и глаголетъ „Царю небесный“, Трисвятое и прочее начала обычайнаго и Ѱаломъ: „Благослови душе моя“ и проч. По „Аллилуя 3. Слава Тебѣ Боже“ Іерей поетъ ектенію мирную, къ которой по моленіи: „О предстоящихъ людехъ“ прилагаетъ и особенную ектенію „О призываніи помощи св. Духа“ находящуюся въ Служебникѣ, которою съ колѣнопреклоненіемъ глаголетъ. По возгласѣ: „Яко подобаетъ“, ликъ поетъ: „Господи воззвахъ“ и стихиры. (Кадизмы нѣтъ.) Слава и Нынѣ. Входъ съ кадилницею. Прокименъ великій: „Кто Богъ велій“ и проч. По прокименѣ Іерей взыйдетъ на амвонъ и возглашаетъ: „Паки и паки колѣна приклонше Господу помолимся“, и приклонивъ колѣна, чтетъ молитву І-ую: „Пречисте, нескверне“ и пр. По семъ вставше, глаголетъ ектенію малую: „Заступи, спаси“ и проч. далѣе ектенію: „Рцемъ вси“. — По ектеніи возглашаетъ: „Паки и паки преклонше колѣна“ и проч. и чтетъ ІІ-ую молитву:
units.english_text: This Vespers on Sunday of the Descent of the Holy Spirit is celebrated immediately after the Divine Liturgy, and that together with the kneeling prayers for the invocation of the Holy Spirit. The order of this Vespers is as follows: After “Blessed be the name of the Lord” the Priest, having entered into the holy altar, beginneth: “Blessed is our God,” etc., and saith “Heavenly King,” the Trisagion, and the rest of the ordinary beginning, and the Psalm: “Bless the Lord, O my soul,” etc. After “Alleluia” (thrice), “Glory to Thee, O God,” the Priest chanteth the litany of peace, unto which after the petition: “For the people here present” he appendeth also the special litany “For the invocation of the help of the Holy Spirit” found in the *Sluzhebnik*, which he reciteth with kneeling. After the exclamation: “For unto Thee is due,” the choir singeth: “Lord, I have cried” and the stichera. (There is no kathisma.) “Glory,” and “Now and.” Entrance with the censer. Great Prokimenon: “Who is a God as great as our God?” etc. After the prokimenon the Priest ascendeth onto the ambo and proclaimeth: “Again and again, having bowed our knees, let us pray unto the Lord,” and having bowed his knees, reciteth the 1st prayer: “O undefiled, unblemished,” etc. After this, having arisen, he saith the small litany: “Help us, save us,” etc., and then the litany: “Let us all say.” — After the litany he proclaimeth: “Again and again, having bowed our knees,” etc., and reciteth the 2nd prayer:

units.slavonic_text: Въ навечеріе Рождества Іисуса Христа порядочно кончатся оутромъ часы царскіи совокупно съ Вечернею и Литургіею св. Василія Великаго. Но если Навечеріе впадетъ на Субботу или на Недѣлю, то отправа подѣлится и то такъ: что часы царскіи предварительно отправляются въ Пятокъ, Вечерня отправляется въ самое Навечеріе (т. е. въ Субботу или въ Недѣлю) вечеромъ 3-го часа съ парамеями вечерными, съ тропарями и съ Апостоломъ и Евангеліемъ Навечерія, Литургія же св. Василія отправляется въ самый день Рождества Христоваго. — О сей великой Вечерни то примѣтимъ, что она имѣетъ начало обычайное. Стихиры на „Господи воззвахъ“ Рождества на 8. Входъ съ кадиломъ и съ Евангеліемъ. По „Свѣте тихій“ Іерей возглашаетъ „Вонмимъ, миръ всѣмъ, премудрость вонмимъ“ и поется прокименъ дню, послѣ котораго бываютъ чтенія 8 съ тропарями. Сіи тропари на 3-ой и по 6-ой пареміи суть вмѣщенны. По скончаніи 8-го чтенія ект. малая и абіе „Вонмимъ, миръ всѣмъ, премудрость вонмимъ“ и берется прокименъ Апостола: „Господь рече ко мнѣ“. — Читается Апостолъ зач. 303. Аллилуя и Еванг. отъ Мат. зач. 53. Потомъ „Рцемъ вси“, „Сподоби Господи“ и „Исполнимъ вечернія молитвы“ и абіе великій отпустъ. — (Стихиры на стиховнѣхъ не суть.) Примѣчаніе. Семъ сходно подѣлится и отправа Навечерія Богоявленія, если оно случится въ Субботу или Недѣлю. Тѣй кромѣ того еще и то потребно примѣтити, что Вечерня сія въ семъ случаѣ не токмо сей подобна есть, но она еще въ такомъ случаю совокупляется и съ водосвятіемъ. — Сирѣчь
units.english_text:
On the Paramony of the Nativity of Jesus Christ, the Royal Hours conclude in order in the morning together with Vespers and the Divine Liturgy of St. Basil the Great. But if the Paramony should fall on a Saturday or on a Sunday, the celebration is divided, and that thus: the Royal Hours are celebrated beforehand on Friday; Vespers is celebrated on the Paramony itself (that is, on Saturday or on Sunday) in the evening at the 3rd hour with the evening paremias, with the troparia, and with the Epistle and Gospel of the Paramony; while the Divine Liturgy of St. Basil is celebrated on the very day of the Nativity of Christ. — Concerning this Great Vespers we note that it hath the ordinary beginning. Stichera at “Lord, I have cried” of the Nativity on 8. Entrance with the censer and with the Gospel. After “Gladsome Light” the Priest proclaimeth: “Let us attend! Peace be to all! Wisdom, let us attend!” and the prokimenon of the day is sung, after which there are 8 readings with troparia. These troparia are inserted at the 3rd and after the 6th paremia. At the conclusion of the 8th reading, the small litany, and immediately: “Let us attend! Peace be to all! Wisdom, let us attend!” and the prokimenon of the Epistle is taken: “The Lord said unto Me” [Ps. 2:7]. — The Epistle is read, pericope 303 [Gal. 3:15–22]. Alleluia and the Gospel from Matthew, pericope 53. Then “Let us all say,” “Vouchsafe, O Lord,” and “Let us complete our evening prayer,” and immediately the great dismissal. — (There are no stichera at the aposticha.)
Note. In like manner the celebration of the Paramony of Theophany is divided, if it should occur on a Saturday or Sunday. There, in addition, it is also necessary to note that this Vespers in this case is not only similar to this one, but in such a case it is also combined with the blessing of water. — That is to say, after the readings, after the Epistle and Gospel and after both litanies, the Priest cometh forth into the midst of the church, where water is prepared, and the choir beginneth to sing: “The voice of the Lord is upon the waters,” and the blessing of water is celebrated, concerning which mention will be made in Article III.

units.slavonic_incipit: Порядочныя Повечерія раздѣляются: α) на малыя
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: рядочныя повечерия разделяются на малыя и
units.slavonic_text: Порядочныя Повечерія раздѣляются: α) на малыя и β) на великія. Изъ чрезвычайныхъ же знаменитнѣйшія суть: α) Повечеріе малое безъ канона. β) Повечерія въ Вел. Постѣ. γ) Повечеріе съ Литіею. Малое Повечеріе оу насъ публично въ церкви лишь въ страстную Середу, Пятокъ и Субботу и на Сошествіе св. Духа отправляется, приватно же дома черезъ цѣлый годъ, еще и въ Великомъ Постѣ въ Субботу и въ Недѣлю (т. е. на Недѣлю и на Понедѣлокъ.) Великое же отправляется публично: α) въ Вторникъ и въ Четверъ (т. е. на Середу и на Пятокъ) сыропустной седмицы. β) Въ Понедѣлокъ, Вторникъ, Середу (съ изятіемъ Середы 5-ой седмицы), Четверъ и Пятокъ (съ изятіемъ Пятка 5-ой седмицы) всѣхъ седмицъ великаго Поста. γ) Въ Понедѣлокъ и Вторникъ страстной седмицы. δ) Въ Навечеріе Рождества Христова и Богоявленія. ε) Въ Навечеріе Благовѣщенія, если той праздникъ случится въ Вторникъ, Середу, Четверъ, Пятокъ и Субботу першихъ 6 седмицъ Великаго Поста, алько если случится въ Вторникъ, Середу и Четверъ страстной седмицы.
units.english_text: Small Compline among us is celebrated publicly in church only on Holy Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday, and on the Descent of the Holy Spirit; but privately at home throughout the entire year, even in the Great Fast on Saturday and on Sunday (that is, for Sunday and for Monday). Great Compline, however, is celebrated publicly: (α) on Tuesday and on Thursday (that is, for Wednesday and for Friday) of Cheesefare Week; (β) on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday (with the exception of Wednesday of the 5th week), Thursday, and Friday (with the exception of Friday of the 5th week) of all weeks of the Great Fast; (γ) on Monday and Tuesday of Passion Week; (δ) on the Paramony of the Nativity of Christ and of Theophany; (ε) on the Paramony of the Annunciation, if that feast should occur on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, or Saturday of the first 6 weeks of the Great Fast, or if it should occur on Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday of Passion Week.

Great Compline, however, is celebrated publicly: (α) on Tuesday and on Thursday (that is, for Wednesday and for Friday) of Cheesefare Week; (β) on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday (with the exception of Wednesday of the 5th week), Thursday, and Friday (with the exception of Friday of the 5th week) of all weeks of the Great Fast; (γ) on Monday and Tuesday of Passion Week; (δ) on the Paramony of the Nativity of Christ and of Theophany; (ε) on the Paramony of the Annunciation, if that feast should occur on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, or Saturday of the first 6 weeks of the Great Fast, or if it should occur on Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday of Passion Week.

units.slavonic_incipit: И абіе: Царю небесный. Трисвятое. Отче
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и абие царю небесный трисвятое отче наш с
units.slavonic_text: И абіе: Царю небесный. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ Возгласомъ. Госп. пом. 12. Прійдите покл. 3. По семъ Іерей входитъ въ св. олтарь, а ликъ читаетъ: псалмы, и то 50-ый (Помилуй мя Боже) 69., и 142-ый (Господи оуслыши молитву мою), по псалмахъ же читаетъ: Слава въ вышнихъ Богъ. Вѣрую. По семъ поется канонъ дневный въ честь Пресв. Богородицы изъ Октоиха.*) (Катавасіа по каждой пѣсни не поется.) По ІІІ-ой пѣсни не поется ектенія, но глаголется: Господи пом. 3. Слава и Нынѣ и Сѣдаленъ. По VI-ой пѣсни такожде: Господи пом. 3. Слава и Нынѣ: Кондакъ и Ікосъ. По окончаніи ІХ-ой пѣсни оба лики совокупно поютъ: „Достойно“**) По семъ: Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ Возгласомъ. Въ Субботу Ѵпакой гласа, если же праздникъ или нарочитый Святый, Кондакъ его; а если день простый, тропарь храму, дню и настоящій: „Боже Отецъ нашихъ“ и пр. (Молитвосл. стр. 271.) Господи пом. 40. Подъ симъ Іерей выходитъ и чтетъ предъ царскими враты молитву „Иже на всякое“ и пр. Ликъ Господи пом. 3. Слава и Нынѣ. Честнѣйшую и пр. Именемъ Господнимъ благослови Отче. И Іерей возглашаетъ: „Боже оущедри ны“ и пр. По „Аминь“ же возглашаетъ молитву: „Нескверная, неблазная“ и проч. и приключаетъ молитву: „И даждь намъ“ и проч. съ „Преславная“ и „Оупованіе намъ“ и пр. По семъ поются тропари: „Помилуй насъ Господи помилуй насъ“ и пр. Слава: „Господи помилуй насъ“ и пр. И нынѣ: „Милосердія двери“ и пр. По сихъ ектенія: „Помилуй насъ Боже“ и пр. „Еще молимся, о еже сохранитися граду сему...“ и по возгласѣ: „Оуслыши ны Боже Спасителю...“ Отпустъ найменшій ѿ „Слава Тебѣ Христе Боже“. По семъ поминанія.***) Если же оутріе будетъ недѣля, праздникъ, или нарочитый Святый, тогда Іерей по „О оумноженіи плодовъ земныхъ“ не поминаетъ оусопшихъ, лишь живыхъ, и прото абіе будетъ „Молитвами свят. Отецъ“ и проч. и такъ бываетъ благословеніе.
units.english_text: And immediately: “Heavenly King.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. “Lord, have mercy” (12 times). “Come, let us worship” (thrice). After this the Priest entereth into the holy altar, and the choir readeth the Psalms, namely the 50th (“Have mercy on me, O God” [Ps. 50]), the 69th [Ps. 69], and the 142nd (“O Lord, hear my prayer” [Ps. 142]); and after the Psalms it readeth: “Glory to God in the highest.” The Creed. After this there is sung the daily canon in honor of the Most Holy Theotokos from the Octoechos.[^100] (Katavasia is not sung after each ode.) After the 3rd ode no litany is sung, but there is said: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and,” and the Sessional Hymn. After the 6th ode likewise: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and,” Kontakion and Ikos. At the conclusion of the 9th ode both choirs together sing: “It is truly right.”[^101] After this: The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. On Saturday, the Hypakoe of the tone; if it be a feast or a commemorated Saint, his Kontakion; but if it be a simple day, the troparion of the temple, of the day, and the present one: “O God of our Fathers,” etc. (*Molitvoslov*, p. 271). “Lord, have mercy” (40 times). During this the Priest cometh forth and before the royal doors reciteth the prayer: “Thou Who at all times,” etc. The choir: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “More honorable,” etc., “In the name of the Lord bless, Father.” And the Priest proclaimeth: “God be merciful unto us,” etc. And after “Amen” he proclaimeth the prayer: “O undefiled, unblemished,” etc., and subjoineth the prayer: “And grant unto us,” etc., with “O most glorious,” and “My hope,” etc. After this the troparia are sung: “Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us,” etc. “Glory,” “O Lord, have mercy on us,” etc. “Now and,” “Open unto us the doors of compassion,” etc. After these, the litany: “Have mercy on us, O God,” etc., “Again we pray that this city may be preserved...” and after the exclamation: “Hear us, O God our Savior...” The smallest dismissal from “Glory to Thee, O Christ God.” After this, the commemorations.[^102] If the morrow be a Sunday, a feast, or a commemorated Saint, then the Priest after “For the abundance of the fruits of the earth” doth not commemorate the departed, but only the living, and therefore immediately followeth: “Through the prayers of our holy Fathers,” etc., and thus the blessing taketh place.

units.slavonic_incipit: Часть І-ая. Іерей въ епитрахилѣ творитъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: част и ая иерей в епитрахиле творит начало обычное
units.slavonic_text: Часть І-ая. Іерей въ епитрахилѣ творитъ начало обычное, глаголя: „Благословенъ Богъ нашъ“ и пр. Ликъ: „Аминь“. И абіе: Царю небесный. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. Господи пом. 12. Слава и Нынѣ. Прійдите покл. 3. Подъ симъ Іерей входитъ въ св. олтарь, пѣвецъ же начнетъ читати псалмы: 4., 6., 12. Слава и Нынѣ. Аллилуя 3. Господи пом. 3. Слава и Нынѣ. Опять псалмы: 24., 30., 90. Слава и Нынѣ. Аллилуя 3. Господи пом. 3. По псалмахъ Іерей выходитъ и велегласитъ пѣніе: „Съ нами Богъ разумѣйте языцы и покаряйтеся, яко съ нами Богъ“, ликъ тожде 2-жды. По семъ Іерей поетъ стихи, ликъ же повторяетъ на единокаждый стихъ „Съ нами Богъ“. По скончаніи сего пѣнія Іерей входитъ, а пѣвецъ читаетъ: „День прешедъ“ и проч. Безплотное. Вѣрую. Пресвятая. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ, и абіе поются тропари. По тропаряхъ ликъ: Господи пом. 40. (и Іерей выходитъ). Слава и Нынѣ. Честнѣйшую. Именемъ Господнимъ благослови Отче. И Іерей возглашаетъ: „Молитвами св. Отецъ“ и пр., и молитвою: „Господи, Господи“ и пр. окончитъ І-ую часть, вшедъ въ олтарь. ІІ-ая часть. Великаго Повечерія начинается воззваніемъ: Прійдите покл. 3., псалмы: 50., 101. По псалмахъ Іерей выходитъ и чтетъ молитву царя Манассіи: „Господи Вседержителю“. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. Кондакъ праздника или дня. Господи пом. 40. Слава и Нынѣ. Честнѣйшую. Именемъ Господнимъ благослови Отче. И Іерей возглашаетъ: „Молитвами св. Отецъ“ и пр. и молитвою: „Владыко Господи Вседержителю“ и пр. окончитъ ІІ-ую часть и идетъ въ св. олтарь. ІІІ-ая часть. Сія часть зачинается воззваніемъ: Прійдите покл. 3., псалмы: 69-ый (Боже въ помощь мою) и 142-ый (Господи оуслыши молитву мою). По семъ: „Слава въ вышнихъ Богъ“ токмо читается. Канонъ, нѣкогда и два.*) По канонѣ спѣвается пѣснь: „Достойно есть“. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. По семъ слѣдуетъ тропарь: „Господи силъ“ и пр. съ псал. 150. „Хвалите Бога въ святыхъ его“ который такъ спѣвается, что до каждаго стиха того псалма припѣвается: „Господи силъ“, на Слава же спѣвается: „Господи аще не быхомъ“ и пр., а на И нынѣ: „Многая множества“ и пр. По семъ: „Всесвятая Богородице“. „Все оупованіе“. По семъ слѣдуетъ Господи пом. 40. И Іерей выходитъ и чтетъ молитву: „Иже на всякое“ и пр., а ликъ:
units.english_text: Part I. The Priest in epitrachelion maketh the ordinary beginning, saying: “Blessed is our God,” etc. The choir: “Amen.” And immediately: “Heavenly King.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. “Lord, have mercy” (12 times). “Glory,” and “Now and.” “Come, let us worship” (thrice). During this the Priest entereth into the holy altar, and the cantor beginneth to read the Psalms: 4, 6, 12. “Glory,” and “Now and.” “Alleluia” (thrice). “Lord, have mercy” (thrice). “Glory,” and “Now and.” Again the Psalms: 24, 30, 90. “Glory,” and “Now and.” “Alleluia” (thrice). “Lord, have mercy” (thrice). After the Psalms the Priest cometh forth and loudly chanteth the hymn: “God is with us, understand, all ye nations, and submit yourselves, for God is with us”; the choir chanteth the same twice. After this the Priest chanteth the verses, and the choir repeateth after each verse: “God is with us.” At the conclusion of this singing the Priest entereth, and the cantor readeth: “The day being past,” etc. “The bodiless.” The Creed. “Most Holy.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation, and immediately the troparia are sung. After the troparia the choir: “Lord, have mercy” (40 times) (and the Priest cometh forth). “Glory,” and “Now and.” “More honorable.” “In the name of the Lord bless, Father.” And the Priest proclaimeth: “Through the prayers of our holy Fathers,” etc., and with the prayer: “O Lord, Lord,” etc., concludeth the 1st part, having entered into the altar.

И Іерей возглашаетъ: „Боже оущедри ны“ и проч. По семъ „Нескверная“ и „И даждь намъ“. „Преславная“. „Оупованіе намъ“. Тропари: „Помилуй насъ Господи“ и проч. Ектенія: „Помилуй насъ Боже“ и проч. Отпустъ. Поминанія. Канона на повечеріи не есть: α) въ дни Мясопустной и Сыропустной седмицы кромѣ Среды и Пятка Сыропустной седмицы. β) Въ день Благовѣщенія, если оно приключится въ вел. Постѣ. Тогда во оутромъ отправляется вел. Повечеріе съ Литіею, а вечеромъ малое безъ канона.*) γ) Въ дни свѣтлой седмицы. δ) Въ дни отъ Понедѣлка св. Духа даже до Недѣли всѣхъ Святыхъ. Примѣчаніе. Повечеріе Свѣтлой седмицы есть данно въ „Тріоди Цвѣтной“.

Commemorations.

units.english_text: There is no canon at Compline: (α) on the days of Meatfare and Cheesefare Weeks, except Wednesday and Friday of Cheesefare Week; (β) on the day of the Annunciation, if it should occur in the Great Fast. Then in the morning Great Compline with Litiya is celebrated, and in the evening Small Compline without a canon;[^104] (γ) on the days of Bright Week; (δ) on the days from Monday of the Holy Spirit even unto the Sunday of All Saints.

(α) Order of Small Compline with Prostrations. — This Compline the Priest must read in his own house on Sundays of the Great Fast. It is the Compline of Monday.[^105] It is celebrated thus: Ordinary beginning: “Blessed is our God,” etc. Come, let us worship (thrice). The Psalms: 50, 69, and 142. After this: “Glory to God in the highest,” the Creed. The Theotokion canon. After the canon: “It is truly right.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. And immediately: the troparia of the temple, of the day, and the present one: “O God of our Fathers.”[^106] After the troparia the choir saith: “Lord, have mercy” (40 times); the Priest, having come forth, saith the prayer: “Thou Who at all times.” The choir: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “More honorable,” “In the name of the Lord bless, Father.” The Priest proclaimeth: “God be merciful unto us,” etc., and maketh 3 great prostrations with the prayer of St. Ephrem (“O Lord and Master of my life”). After this, the Trisagion (thrice), “O Most Holy Trinity,” “Our Father” with the exclamation. “Lord, have mercy” (12 times). The prayer: “O undefiled,” etc., “And grant unto us,” “O most glorious,” “Our hope,” etc. The smallest dismissal from “Glory to Thee, O Christ God, our hope, glory to Thee.” The commemorations, and thus the blessing. (The troparia: “Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us,” etc., and the litany: “Have mercy on us, O God,” are omitted.)
(β) Order of Great Compline in the First Week of the Holy Great Fast. — Part I. The Priest in epitrachelion beginneth, saying: “Blessed is our God,” unto which the choir: “Amen.” And immediately: “Heavenly King.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. “Lord, have mercy” (12 times). “Glory,” and “Now and.” “Come, let us worship” (thrice). Then the Priest entereth into the holy altar, and the cantor readeth the 69th Psalm (“O God, come to my assistance” [Ps. 69]). After the Psalm, the Great Canon of St. Andrew of Crete.[^107] After the canon “It is truly right” is not sung, but instead of it the 9th ode is repeated, and one prostration even unto the ground is made. After this the Psalms: 4, 6, 12. “Glory,” and “Now and.” “Alleluia” (thrice). “Lord, have mercy” (thrice). “Glory,” and “Now and,” and immediately the Psalms: 24, 30, 90. “Glory,” and “Now and.” “Alleluia” (thrice). “Lord, have mercy” (thrice). And the Priest, having come forth, chanteth the hymn: “God is with us,” the choir twice. The Priest chanteth the verses, the cantor appendeth after each verse: “God is with us.” After this hymn the Priest entereth into the holy altar, and the cantor readeth: “The day being past,” etc., “The bodiless nature,” etc., “Most Holy Virgin.” The Creed. “O Most Holy Lady, pray to God for us sinners” — twice; while the 1st choir reciteth, the other maketh a prostration, — and while the other choir ariseth and answereth, the 1st choir maketh a prostration. Likewise also at the other verses.[^108] After these petitions, the Trisagion, “Our Father” with the exclamation. After this on Monday and Wednesday the troparia: “Enlighten mine eyes,”

units.slavonic_text: маломъ, ни на великомъ Повечеріи не берутся, токмо въ Страстную седмицу, въ Середу, Пятокъ и Субботу на маломъ Повечеріи, какъ то оу насъ обычай есть. δ) Чинъ Повечерія Великаго въ Пяткахъ Вел. Поста.*) Повечеріе сіе есть безъ поклоновъ, ибо въ греческой Церкви поклоны въ Субботу не бываютъ. Оно сякъ отправляется: І. Часть. Начало обычайное съ Ѱалмами, съ „Съ нами Богъ“ и съ прочими моленіями даже до „Отче наш“-а. По семъ берется тропарь и то: въ Пятокъ І-ой седмицы тропарь св. мученика Ѳеодора; въ Пятки ІІ-ой, ІІІ-ой и IV-ой седмицы вел. Поста тропарь Мученикамъ и о Оусопшихъ; въ Пятокъ V-ой седмицы есть малое Повечеріе съ тропарями Акаѳиста и велик. Канона; въ Пятокъ VI-ой седмицы есть тропарь св. Лазаря. По данномъ тропарю слѣдуетъ Господи пом. 40. Слава и Нынѣ. Честнѣйшую, и Іерей возглашаетъ: „Молитвами св. Отецъ“ и пр. и молитвою: „Господи, Господи“ окончитъ І-ую часть. units.english_text: (δ) Order of Great Compline on the Fridays of the Great Fast.[^111] This Compline is without prostrations, for in the Greek Church there are no prostrations on Saturday. It is celebrated thus: Part I. Ordinary beginning with the Psalms, with “God is with us,” and with the other petitions even unto “Our Father.” After this the troparion is taken, namely: on Friday of the 1st week, the troparion of the Holy Martyr Theodore; on Fridays of the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th weeks of the Great Fast, the troparion to the Martyrs and for the Departed; on Friday of the 5th week there is Small Compline with the troparia of the Akathist and of the Great Canon; on Friday of the 6th week there is the troparion of St. Lazarus. After the given troparion followeth: “Lord, have mercy” (40 times), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “More honorable,” and the Priest proclaimeth: “Through the prayers of our holy Fathers,” etc., and with the prayer: “O Lord, Lord,” concludeth the 1st part. Part II is celebrated in the ordinary manner even unto “Our Father.” After this the troparia: “Have mercy on us, O Lord,” etc. Then: “Lord, have mercy” (40 times), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “More honorable.” The Priest proclaimeth: “Through the prayers of our holy Fathers,” etc., and with the prayer: “O Master, God,” etc., concludeth the 2nd part.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: чин повечерия великаго с литиею
units.slavonic_text: Чинъ Повечерія Великаго съ Литіею.
units.english_text: The Priest in phelonion and epitrachelion censeth the holy sanctuary, openeth the royal doors, censeth the whole church, standeth before the royal doors, and when the chanter saith: “Command!” he beginneth: “O Lord, bless!” And he proclaimeth: “Glory to the holy...” — and thus followeth: “Come, let us worship.” The Priest, having entered after this into the holy sanctuary, shutteth the royal doors, and having divested of the phelonion, in the epitrachelion cometh forth before the royal doors. The chanter meanwhile beginneth Part I of Great Compline, saying after “Come, let us worship” 3 psalms. The Priest goeth into the holy sanctuary, and the chanter readeth Psalms: 4, 6, 12 [Pss. 4, 6, 12]. “Glory,” and “Now and,” “Alleluia” (thrice), “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and.” And immediately Psalms: 24, 30, and the 90th [Pss. 24, 30, 90]. “Glory,” and “Now and,” “Alleluia” (thrice), “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and.” And immediately the Priest cometh forth and singeth once: “God is with us.” The choir repeateth this 1st verse twice. After this the Priest, standing before the royal doors, readeth the verses: “Unto the ends of the earth,” etc., and the choir after each verse singeth: “God is with us,” etc. At the end the Priest again singeth this first verse once, and the choir repeateth it twice. After this canticle of the Prophet Isaiah there followeth: “The day being past,” etc., “The bodiless nature,” “O Most Holy Virgin,” “I believe,” “O Most Holy Trinity,” each verse twice. After these: The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. The troparion of the feast (for instance, of the Nativity of Christ, the Theophany, or the Annunciation), and that once. “Lord, have mercy” (40 times), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “More honorable,” “In the name of the Lord,” etc. And the Priest proclaimeth: “Through the prayers of our holy Fathers,” etc., and with the prayer: “O Lord, Lord of hosts,” concludeth Part I, having entered into the sanctuary. Part II beginneth from “Come, let us worship” (thrice), after which follow Psalms: 50 and the 101st [Pss. 50, 101]. The prayer of King Manasses, which the Priest readeth before the royal doors. The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. The kontakion of the feast. “Lord, have mercy” (40 times), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “More honorable,” “In the name of the Lord,” etc., and the Priest proclaimeth: “O Lord Jesus Christ,” etc., and with the prayer: “O Master, God the Father,” etc., concludeth Part II, having entered into the holy sanctuary. Part III beginneth from “Come, let us worship” (thrice). After this Psalms: 69 and the 142nd [Pss. 69, 142]. “Glory to God in the highest” is read. — Meanwhile the Priest vesteth in the phelonion, openeth the royal doors, blesseth the censer, and in the usual manner, as at the entrance, goeth forth by the northern door, censeth the entire church, and after the censing goeth unto the table or *Tetrapod* in the midst of the church, where there are already prepared 5 loaves or prosphora, wheat, wine, and oil. The arrangement of the *Tetrapod* is thus: on the right side is placed the wine, on the left the oil, in the middle the wheat, and upon it 5 loaves (prosphora), and that four prosphora are placed cruciformly, and the fifth lieth upon them touching all four. After this the choir after “Glory to God in the highest,” etc., singeth the stichera at the Litiya (and that 5 with “Glory,” and “Now and”), and upon the conclusion of these the Priest chanteth the litany at the Litiya: “Save, O God, Thy people,” etc. After this, the stichera at the aposticha. Next: “Now Thou lettest depart.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. The troparion of the feast (thrice). (When the Priest singeth the troparion, he at the same time also censeth.) After the troparion the Priest proclaimeth: “Let us pray to the Lord,” and readeth the prayer over the blessing of the loaves: “O Lord Jesus Christ,” etc., taking first the prosphora lying on top, and having then set it back in its place, with outstretched fingers he signeth the entire oblation at the words: “Bless these loaves, the wheat, the wine, and the oil” with a single sign of the cross. After this prayer followeth: “Blessed be the name of the Lord” (thrice), while the Priest censeth the oblation, — and after this Psalm 33 [Ps. 33] is read up to “Shall not want any good thing.” The Priest goeth unto the royal doors, and the chanter upon the conclusion of the psalm saith: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “In the name of the Lord bless, Father”; and the Priest standing before the royal doors, at the exclamation of the choir: “In the name of the Lord bless, Father,” beginneth Matins, saying: “Glory to the holy...” etc.[^113]

units.slavonic_text: свят. олтарь. ІІІ-ая часть зачинается отъ „Прійдите покло- нимся 3.“ По семъ Ѱалмы: 69. и 142-ый. „Слава въ вышнихъ Богу“ читается. — Подъ симъ Іерей облекается въ фелонъ, отви- раетъ царскія двери, благословляетъ кадило и обычайно, какъ на входѣ, исходитъ сѣверными дверьми, кадитъ всю церковь, и по каденіи идетъ къ столꙋ или тетраподꙋ на серединѣ церкви, гдѣ пріуготовленны суть оуже 5 хлѣбовъ или просфоры, пшеница, вино и елей. Оустроеніе тетрапода такъ бываетъ: Отъ правой стороны поставляется вино, отъ лѣвой же елей, посредѣ пшеница, верхъ же ея 5 хлѣбовъ (просфоръ), и то четыре просфоры крестооб- разно полагаются, а пятая прикосното всѣхъ четырехъ на нихъ лежитъ. По семъ ликъ по „Слава въ вышнихъ“ и пр. поетъ сти- хиры на Литіи (и то 5 съ Слава и Нынѣ), а по окончанію сихъ Іерей поетъ ектенію на Литіи: „Спаси Боже люди твоя“ и пр. По семъ стихиры на стиховнѣхъ. Далѣе: „Нынѣ отпущаеши“. Три- святое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. Тропарь праздника 3. (Когда Іерей поетъ тропарь, разомъ и кадитъ.) По тропарю Іерей возгла- шаетъ: „Господу помолимся“, и чтетъ молитву на благословеніе хлѣбовъ: „Господи Іисусе Христе“ и пр. взимая первѣе на верхъ лежащую просфору, по семъ положивше ю на мѣсто, протяжен- ными перстами знаменуетъ цѣлое предложеніе на словахъ: „Бла- гослови хлѣбы, пшеницꙋ, вино и елей“ однимъ знакомъ креста. По сей молитвѣ бываетъ: „Буди имя Господне“ 3., когда Іерей кадитъ предложеніе, — и по семъ читается Ѱаломъ 33. до „Не лишатся всякаго блага“ Іерей же идетъ къ царскимъ вратамъ, а пѣвецъ по окончаніи псалма Господи помилуй 3. Слава и Нынѣ. „Именемъ Господнимъ благослови Отче“, Іерей же стоя передъ царскими дверьми, на возгласъ лика: „Именемъ Господнимъ бла- гослови Отче“ начинаетъ Оутреню, глаголя „Слава святѣй“ и пр.*) Надо замѣтити, что если Повечеріе съ Литіею есть сово- купленно, то изъ Повечерія все заченше отъ канона оставляется.

units.slavonic_incipit: Въ дни седмичніи чтется обычно на
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в дни седмичнии чтется обычно на едине но
units.slavonic_text: Въ дни седмичніи чтется обычно на единѣ, но нѣкогда и поется въ церкви предъ Оутренею. — Если въ церкви поемъ Полу- нощницу сію, то Іерей въ епитрахилѣ предъ царскими дверми творитъ обычное начало, возглашая: „Благословенъ Богъ нашъ“ и пр. По семъ: Царю небесный. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгла- сомъ. Господи пом. 12. Прійдите покл. 3. И Іерей входитъ въ св. олтарь. Ѱаломъ 50. Кадизма 17-ая, которая имѣетъ 3 Анти- фоны. Предъ 2-ымъ и 3-ымъ Антифономъ Аллилуя 3. Господи пом. 3. Слава и Нынѣ. По семъ: Вѣрую. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. Тропари: „Се женихъ“, Слава: „День онъ“ и Нынѣ: „Тебе необоримую стѣну“, и абіе Господи пом. 40. По семъ Іерей выходитъ и чтетъ молитву: „Иже на всякое время“. По семъ: „Господи пом. 3. Слава и Нынѣ. Честнѣйшую. Именемъ Господнимъ и пр. и Іерей абіе возглашаетъ: „Боже оущедри ны“ и пр., на что ликъ отвѣчаетъ: „Аминь“. По семъ Іерей молит- вою: „Владыко Боже Отче“ и пр. заключаетъ І-ую часть. ІІ-ая часть начинается отъ: „Прійдите покл. 3.“, и абіе Ѱалмы: 120. и 133-ый. Слава и Нынѣ. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. По возгласѣ слѣдуютъ тропари о оусопшихъ: „По- мяни Господи“, „Глубиною мудрости“, Слава: „Со святыми оупокой“, И нынѣ: „Блажимъ Тя всѣ роди“ и пр. По семъ пѣ- вецъ глаголетъ: Господи пом. 12., на что Іерей читаетъ молитву: „Помяни Господи“. Додаются еще тропари: „Помилуй насъ Го- споди“ и пр. Ектенія: „Помилуй насъ Боже“ и пр. (Молитвосл. стр. 47.) По сихъ отпустъ найменьшій. Поминанія. „Помолимся О святѣйшемъ Архіереи“ и пр. Далѣе по поминаніяхъ Іерей веле- гласитъ молитвы: „Ослаби, остави“, „Ненавидящія“ и проч. и даетъ Благословеніе.
units.english_text: On weekdays it is usually read in private, but sometimes it is also sung in church before Matins. — If we sing this Midnight Office in church, the Priest in the epitrachelion before the royal doors maketh the usual beginning, proclaiming: “Blessed is our God,” etc. After this: “O Heavenly King,” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. “Lord, have mercy” (12 times), “Come, let us worship” (thrice). And the Priest entereth into the holy sanctuary. Psalm 50 [Ps. 50]. The 17th Kathisma, which hath 3 antiphons. Before the 2nd and 3rd antiphons: “Alleluia” (thrice), “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and.” After this: “I believe.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. Troparia: “Behold, the Bridegroom,” “Glory,” “That day,” and “Now and,” “Thee, the invincible rampart”; and immediately “Lord, have mercy” (40 times). After this the Priest cometh forth and readeth the prayer: “Thou Who at all times.” After this: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and,” “More honorable,” “In the name of the Lord,” etc., and the Priest immediately proclaimeth: “God be merciful unto us,” etc., whereunto the choir answereth: “Amen.” After this the Priest with the prayer: “O Master, God the Father,” etc., concludeth Part I.

units.english_text: Part II beginneth from: “Come, let us worship” (thrice), and immediately Psalms: 120 and the 133rd [Pss. 120, 133]. “Glory,” and “Now and.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. After the exclamation follow the troparia for the departed: “Remember, O Lord,” “With profound wisdom,” “Glory,” “With the Saints give rest,” “Now and,” “All generations bless thee,” etc. After this the chanter saith: “Lord, have mercy” (12 times), whereunto the Priest readeth the prayer: “Remember, O Lord.” There are added also the troparia: “Have mercy on us, O Lord,” etc. Litany: “Have mercy on us, O God,” etc. (*Molitvoslov*, p. 47). After these, the smallest dismissal. Commemorations: “Let us pray for our most holy Hierarch,” etc. Furthermore after the commemorations the Priest proclaimeth aloud the prayers: “Remit, forgive,” “Those who hate,” etc., and giveth the blessing.

units.slavonic_incipit: Полунощница Субботная такъ отправляется, какъ и
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: лунощница субботная так отправляется как и повсед невная
units.slavonic_text: Полунощница Субботная такъ отправляется, какъ и Повсед- невная, лишь α) вмѣсто 17-ой кадизмы берется 9-ая кадизма, т. е. Ѱалмы: 64., 65., 66., 67., 68. и 69-ый. β) Вмѣсто тропа- рей: „Се женихъ“ и пр. читаются тропари въ честь пресв. Тройцы: „Несозданное естество“. На конецъ γ) вмѣсто молитвы: „Нена- видящія“ и пр. берется молитва св. Евстратія: „Величая вели- чаю тя“ и пр.
units.english_text: The Saturday Midnight Office is celebrated in the same manner as the daily one, except that: (α) instead of the 17th Kathisma the 9th Kathisma is taken, that is to say, Psalms: 64, 65, 66, 67, 68, and the 69th [Pss. 64, 65, 66, 67, 68, 69]; (β) instead of the troparia: “Behold, the Bridegroom,” etc., there are read the troparia in honor of the Most Holy Trinity: “Uncreated nature”; finally (γ) instead of the prayer: “Those who hate,” etc., the prayer of St. Eustratius is taken: “Magnifying, I magnify Thee,” etc.

По семъ (вмѣсто ка- дизмы) канонъ къ пресв. Тройцѣ, который находится въ Октоихѣ, при каждомъ гласѣ. During this the Priest entereth into the holy sanctuary, and the chanter beginneth to read Psalm 50 [Ps. 50]. After the canon, first the Triadicon Megalynarion, consisting of several troparia (“It is truly meet to praise Thee, Who art God,” “The Chief of the Cherubim,” “Unto the unoriginate Father and God,” “Let us all sing,” “With radiant,” “Before Whom tremble,” “It is truly meet reverently,” “Receive tears,” “Glory,” “O Father Almighty,” and at the end “Now and,” “From the dead”). After this is sung the Megalynarion of the Theotokos: “It is truly right,” and thus: The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation and (among us) the Troparia:[^115] “Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us,” and the litany: “Have mercy on us, O God,” etc., with the exclamation: “Hear us, O God.” After the litany the smallest dismissal, and that the resurrectional one (“Christ, our true God, Who rose from the dead,” etc.). Commemorations. (The commemoration for the departed is omitted.) The prayer: “Remit, forgive,” etc., and the prayer to the Most Holy Trinity: “All-powerful and life-creating,” and thus the blessing.

units.english_text: It is celebrated in the same manner as the daily Midnight Office at other times, except that it is necessary to note that at the end of Part I, after “God be merciful unto us,” etc., and before the prayer: “O Master, God the Father,” there are prostrations with the prayer of St. Ephrem: “O Lord and Master,” etc. And that is: (α) three great prostrations with the prayer of St. Ephrem. (A great prostration is when a man falleth upon his knees and boweth his head unto the earth as far as he can.) (β) 12 lesser prostrations (with the verses: “O God, be merciful unto me a sinner”; “O God, cleanse my sins and have mercy on me”; and “Without number have I sinned, O Lord, forgive me”). After the prayer: “O Master, God the Father,” again one great prostration. The rest in the usual manner.

И „Безъ числа согрѣшихъ Господи, прости мя“.) По молитвѣ: „Владыко Боже Отче“ опять одинъ великій поклонъ. Прочая обычайно.

units.english_text: If a certain feast of the Lord, or a feast of the Mother of God, or a feast of a great Saint, or the Afterfeast of the Nativity of Christ and the Theophany fall upon weekdays whereon Litiya is not celebrated: then the Midnight Office is celebrated in the same manner as the daily Midnight Office, except that: (α) the troparion: “Behold, the Bridegroom,” etc., is omitted, and instead of these the troparion of the feast is sung; (β) the troparion and prayer for the departed are omitted, and instead of them the kontakion of the feast is sung. Upon the conclusion of the kontakion there are sung among us the Troparia: “Have mercy on us, O Lord,” etc., and the litany: “Have mercy on us, O God,” etc., with the exclamation: “Hear us, O God.”[^116] Dismissal. Commemorations. (The commemoration for the departed is omitted.) Blessing. (The last two prayers are omitted.)

units.english_text: Before the Resurrection of Christ, likewise before midnight, there is to be celebrated the Midnight Office, or the so-called “Burial Service” (*Nadhrobne*). And that in the following order: The Priest, vested in a black epitrachelion, before the royal doors beginneth the Midnight Office with: “Blessed is our God.” After this the choir: “Amen,” “O Heavenly King,” “Our Father,” “Come, let us worship” (thrice). Psalm 50 [Ps. 50]. And there followeth the Matins canon of Great Saturday: “By a wave of the sea.” After the canon, instead of “It is truly right,” the Heirmos: “Weep not for Me, O Mother.” And immediately: The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. Troparia: “When Thou didst descend,” “The noble Joseph,” and “Unto the Myrrhbearers.” After these the Priest goeth from the royal doors unto the Tomb, and having bowed, censeth the Shroud (*Plashchanytsia*), and after this transferreth It unto the holy table, where he spreadeth It out and again censeth It. After this he saith the litany: “Have mercy on us, O God,” etc., as at the Sunday Midnight Office. Dismissal.

units.slavonic_incipit: Предъ Воскресеніемъ Христовымъ, таже предъ полнощію
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: пред воскресением христовым таже пред полнощию от правлятися
units.slavonic_text: Предъ Воскресеніемъ Христовымъ, таже предъ полнощію от- правлятися имѣетъ Полунощница, или такъ реченное: „Надгроб- ное“. И то слѣдующимъ чиномъ. Іерей въ черномъ епитрахилѣ облеченъ, предъ царскими дверми начинаетъ Полунощницу съ „Бла- гословенъ Богъ нашъ“. По семъ ликъ: Аминь. Царю небесный. Отче нашъ. Прійдите покл. 3. Ѱаломъ 50. И слѣдуетъ канонъ оутренный Великой Субботы: „Волною морскою“. По канонѣ вмѣсто „Достойно есть“ Ірмосъ: „Не рыдай мене Мати“. И абіе: Три- святое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. Тропари „Егда снизшелъ еси“. „Благообразный“ и „Мироносицамъ“. Послѣ сихъ Іерей отъ цар- скихъ дверей идетъ къ Гробу, поклонившеся, покадитъ плащаницу, и по семъ перенесетъ ю на престолъ, гдѣ распростретъ и вновь покадитъ ю. По семъ глаголетъ ектенію: „Помилуй насъ Боже“ и проч., какъ на Полунощницѣ Недѣльной. Отпустъ.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: великая же отправляется по праздникам и по неделям
units.slavonic_text: Великая же отправляется по праздникамъ и по Недѣлямъ. И семѣ сходно она есть: Праздничная и Недѣльная. Но понеже праздники суть двоякого рода: славословительніи и по- луелейніи, то и праздничніи оутрени суть двоякаго рода, сирѣчь: α) съ Славословіемъ, но безъ полуелея, β) же съ Сла- вословіемъ и съ полуелеемъ. Кромѣ сихъ порядочныхъ Оутреней суть еще и чрезвычай- ныя изъ нихъ же знаменитнѣйшы суть слѣдующія: α) Оутреня о оусопшихъ. β) Оутрени въ великомъ Постѣ. γ) Оутреня съ Акаѳистомъ. δ) Оутрени въ страстной седмицѣ. ε) Оутреня съ статіями въ св. Вел. Субботу. ζ) Оутрени въ Свѣтлой Сед- мицѣ. ϑ) Оутреня на Воздвиженіе ч. Креста.
units.english_text: Great Matins, however, is celebrated on feasts and on Sundays. And in accordance with this it is: Festal and Sunday. But since feasts are of two kinds: those with the Doxology and those with the Polyeleos, so also festal Matins services are of two kinds, that is to say: (α) with the Doxology, but without the Polyeleos; (β) with both the Doxology and the Polyeleos.

units.slavonic_text: Если нѣтъ Полунощницы въ Церкви,*) тогда Іерей вшедъ въ храмъ, предъ царскими дверми три поклоненія творитъ, и цѣло- вавъ и возложивъ на себя епитрахиль, начнетъ обычно „Благо- словенъ Богъ нашъ“. Ликъ: Аминь, и абіе Царю небесный. Три- святое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. Господи помилуй 12. Прійдите поклонимся 3. Ѱалмы 19. и 20-ый, послѣ которыхъ Слава и Нынѣ. Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. И посемъ чтецъ глаголетъ тропарь „Спаси Господи люди твоя“ и пр. Слава: „Вознесыйся на крестъ“ и пр. И нынѣ: Богородиченъ: „Предстательство страш- ное“ и пр. По окончаніи сихъ тропарей Іерей возглашаетъ ектенію: „Помилуй насъ Боже“ и пр. „Еще молимся о благовѣрномъ царѣ нашемъ“ и пр., на которыя моленія ликъ отвѣчаетъ: Господи пом. 6 разъ. Таже возгласъ: „Яко милостивъ“ и пр. На что ликъ отвѣчаетъ: Аминь, и абіе велегласитъ: „Именемъ Господнимъ благослови Отче“. Іерей же возглашаетъ: „Слава святѣй, едино- сущнѣй и животворящѣй“ и пр. Ликъ: „Аминь“, и начинаетъ первѣе: „Слава въ вышнихъ Богъ“ 3-жды, по семъ: „Господи, оустнѣ мои“ и проч. 2-жды. И по ряду глаголетъ шестопсалміе (т. е. Ѱалмы: 3., 37., 62., 87., 102. и 142-ый) тихимъ голосомъ. По изреченіи трехъ Ѱалмовъ: Слава и Нынѣ. Аллилуя 3. Господи
units.english_text: If there be no Midnight Office in church,[^117] then the Priest, having entered into the church, maketh three bows before the royal doors, and having kissed and put on the epitrachelion, beginneth in the usual manner: “Blessed is our God.” The choir: “Amen,” and immediately: “O Heavenly King,” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. “Lord, have mercy” (12 times), “Come, let us worship” (thrice). Psalms: 19 and the 20th [Pss. 19, 20], after which: “Glory,” and “Now and.” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. And after this the reader saith the troparion: “Save, O Lord, Thy people,” etc., “Glory,” “Thou Who wast voluntarily lifted up upon the Cross,” etc., “Now and,” Theotokion: “O fearsome defense,” etc. Upon the conclusion of these troparia the Priest proclaimeth the litany: “Have mercy on us, O God,” etc., “Furthermore let us pray for our most devout Emperor,” etc., unto which petitions the choir answereth: “Lord, have mercy” (6 times). Then the exclamation: “For a merciful and man-befriending God art Thou,” etc. Whereunto the choir answereth: “Amen,” and immediately proclaimeth aloud: “In the name of the Lord bless, Father.” And the Priest proclaimeth: “Glory to the holy, consubstantial, and life-creating...” etc. The choir: “Amen,” and beginneth first: “Glory to God in the highest” (thrice), after this: “O Lord, open Thou my lips,” etc. (twice). And in order it saith the Six Psalms (that is to say, Psalms: 3, 37, 62, 87, 102, and the 142nd [Pss. 3, 37, 62, 87, 102, 142]) in a quiet voice. After the recitation of three Psalms: “Glory,” and “Now and,” “Alleluia” (thrice), “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and.” Upon the completion of the Six Psalms: “Glory,” and “Now and,” “Alleluia” (thrice), “Glory to Thee, O God” (the third time with chanting). After this the Priest, standing before the royal doors, saith the litany of peace: “In peace let us pray to the Lord.” After its exclamation the Priest singeth: “God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us,” etc., and the chanter repeateth it 4 times (according to the verses). The Priest, having bowed, withdraweth unto his place, and there secretly reciteth the morning prayers; and the chanter beginneth to sing the troparia, and that: the troparion of the Saint (twice); “Glory,” and “Now and,” the dismissal Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint (or as the typikon prescribeth). After the troparia followeth: Kathisma 1. The 1st Sessional Hymn with the Theotokion. Kathisma 2. The 2nd Sessional Hymn. (Before the kathisma, both the 1st and the 2nd, the choir saith: “Lord, have mercy” [thrice] and “Glory,” and the reader continueth from “Now and.” After the kathisma: “Lord, have mercy” [twice], “To Thee, O Lord,” “Amen.”) After the 2nd Sessional Hymn and after “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), “Glory,” and “Now and,” the chanter readeth Psalm 50 [Ps. 50]. After this the canons, usually 3 (two from the Octoechos, and one of the Saint). The troparia in the canons are read with the appropriate refrains, and that: let there be 14 troparia in all with “Glory,” and with “Now and.” The heirmoi are taken from the first canon. The heirmoi from the canon of the Saint are taken as the Katavasia, but only after the 3rd, 6th, 8th, and 9th odes. After the 3rd ode there is the small litany and the Sessional Hymn from the Common Menaion, that is to say, of the Saint. — After the 6th ode, the small litany, the kontakion and ikos of the Saint. Towards the end of the 8th ode instead of “Glory” we say: “We bless the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit, the Lord”; before the Katavasia the choir saith in the tone of the canon of the Saint: “We praise, we bless, we worship,” etc., and they sing the Heirmos of the 8th ode of the canon of the Saint as Katavasia. After the 8th ode the Priest in the sanctuary proclaimeth: “The Theotokos and Mother of Light in hymns let us magnify,” whereunto the choir loudly singeth: “My soul doth magnify the Lord,” etc., chanting unto the verses: “More honorable than the Cherubim,” etc. After the Katavasia of the 9th ode: “It is truly right.” The small litany and the Exaposteilarion, and that of the day; “Glory,” of the Saint; “Now and,” Theotokion, or if it be Wednesday or Friday: Stavrotheotokion. And immediately Psalms: 148, 149, and the 150th [Pss. 148, 149, 150] are read (“Praise the Lord from the heavens,” “Sing unto the Lord a new song,” and “Praise God in His Saints”). Upon the conclusion of Psalm 150, the Priest proclaimeth from the sanctuary: “Glory to God Who hath shown us the light,” and the choir readeth the Doxology in order: “Glory to God in the highest.”[^118]

units.slavonic_incipit: По семъ Іерей выходитъ изъ олтаря
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: сем иерей выходит из олтаря и перед
units.slavonic_text: По семъ Іерей выходитъ изъ олтаря и передъ царскими дверми глаголетъ ектенію: „Исполнимъ оутреннія“. По 2-омъ возгласѣ сей ектеніи Іерей входитъ въ олтарь, ликъ же зачнетъ спѣвати стихиры на стиховнѣхъ (изъ Октоиха) съ обычными припѣвами. (Передъ 1-ою нѣтъ стиха, передъ 2-ою и 3-ою: „Исполнихомся заўтра милости“, и „Буди свѣтлость Господа нашего на насъ“.) На конецъ: „Слава и Нынѣ“ Богородиченъ или Крестобогороди- ченъ.*) По семъ ликъ читаетъ „Благо есть“, Трисвятое. Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. По семъ тропарь Святаго. Слава и Нынѣ. Богородиченъ отпустительный по гласу Святаго. Іерей по семъ выходитъ изъ олтаря и передъ царскими дверми поетъ ектенію: „Помилуй насъ Боже“. Отпустъ дневный, и то малый и благо- словеніе.
units.english_text: After this the Priest cometh forth from the sanctuary and before the royal doors saith the litany: “Let us complete our morning prayer.” After the 2nd exclamation of this litany the Priest entereth into the sanctuary, and the choir beginneth to sing the stichera at the aposticha (from the Octoechos) with the usual refrains. (Before the 1st there is no verse; before the 2nd and 3rd: “We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy,” and “Let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us” [Ps. 89:14, 17]). At the end: “Glory,” and “Now and,” Theotokion or Stavrotheotokion.[^119] After this the choir readeth: “It is good to give praise,” The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. After this the troparion of the Saint. “Glory,” and “Now and,” the dismissal Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint. The Priest after this cometh forth from the sanctuary and before the royal doors chanteth the litany: “Have mercy on us, O God.” The daily dismissal, and that the small one, and the blessing.

units.slavonic_incipit: α) Оутреня съ великимъ Славословіемъ. Сія
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оутреня с великим славословием сия оутреня отправляется
units.slavonic_text: α) Оутреня съ великимъ Славословіемъ. Сія Оутреня отправляется въ праздники маліи, сирѣчь тогда, когда праздникъ, либо Святый имѣетъ стихиры на 6 и великое Славо- словіе. Она заченше отъ переду, даже до Славословія есть ма- лая,**) и лишь тутъ при концѣ „Хвалите“-хъ Іерей облекается въ епитрахиль и фелонъ, и станетъ передъ св. Трапезою, ожидая конецъ стихиръ на Хвалитехъ. — Когда же пѣвецъ окончитъ сія, тогда растворяетъ царскія двери и возглашаетъ: „Слава Богу, показавшему намъ свѣтъ“, и на амвонъ идетъ и тутъ съ пѣвцемъ поетъ Славословіе.***) По семъ Трисвятое 3. И абіе тро- парь праздника съ Богородичнымъ, по немже Іерей входитъ къ св Трапезѣ и туй поетъ ектеніи: „Пом. Боже“ и „Исполнимъ“.
units.english_text: (α) Matins with the Great Doxology. This Matins is celebrated on minor feasts, that is to say, when the feast or the Saint hath stichera on 6 and the Great Doxology. Beginning from the start, up unto the Doxology, it is small,[^120] and only here towards the end of the Praises (*Ainoi*) the Priest vesteth in the epitrachelion and phelonion, and standeth before the Holy Table, awaiting the end of the stichera at the Praises. — When the chanter hath concluded these, then he openeth the royal doors and proclaimeth: “Glory to God, Who hath shown us the light,” and goeth forth onto the ambo and there with the chanter singeth the Doxology.[^121] After this The Trisagion (thrice). And immediately the troparion of the feast with the Theotokion, after which the Priest entereth unto the Holy Table and there chanteth the litanies: “Have mercy on us, O God,” and “Let us complete.”

units.slavonic_text: Отпустъ великій, и давъ благословеніе, затворяетъ царскія двери. (Стихиры на Стиховнѣхъ не сѣть.)*) β) Оутреня съ полуелеемъ, съ Евангеліемъ и съ великимъ Славословіемъ. Она отправляется въ дни сед- мичныи, аще случится Святаго, имѣющаго полуелей, или праз- дникъ Господскій, или Богородичный. Чинъ сей оутрени есть слѣ- дующій: Іерей возложивъ на себя епитрахиль; приходитъ предъ царскія двери, и тамо оучинивъ поклоненіе, глаголетъ: „Благосло- венъ Богъ нашъ“. Ликъ: „Аминь“. Таже (если не была Полунощ- ница) Царю небесный. Послѣ сего и прочее начало обычнаго. По Прійдите покл. 3. Псалмы: 19. и 20-ый. И абіе Трисвятое Отче нашъ съ возгласомъ. По семъ читаются тропари: „Спаси Боже люди Твоя“ и проч., по которыхъ ектенія за царя съ возгла- сомъ. На возгласъ ликъ отвѣчаетъ: „Аминь“, и абіе возглашаетъ: „Именемъ Господнимъ благослови Отче“. На сіе Іерей: „Слава святѣй“ и пр. Ликъ: Аминь и абіе „Слава въ вышнихъ Богъ“ и пр. 3. „Господи оустнѣ мои“ и пр. 2-жды. И слѣдуетъ шесто- псалміе. (Іерей входитъ въ св. олтарь и глаголетъ молитвы Іерейскія оутренныя.) По шестопсалміи Іерей выходитъ и поется ектенія мирная. „Богъ Господь и явися намъ“ и пр. 4-разъ. Тропари праздничніи. Кадизма 1. Сѣдаленъ 1-ый Святаго. Ка- дизма 2. Сѣдаленъ 2-ый Святаго.**) По семъ: „Слава и Нынѣ“ Богородиченъ, и вмѣсто 3-ой кадизмы ликъ поетъ Полуелей, (т. е. стихи изъ 19-ой кадизмы: „Хвалите имя Господне“ и пр.) По семъ: „Величаніе съ стихами. Послѣ сего глаголется ектенія малая и ликъ поетъ Сѣдаленъ 3-ый (полуелейный.) Слава и Нынѣ Богородиченъ. Таже степенны 4-го гласа 1-ый Антифонъ: „Отъ юности“, которыя на 4 стихи поются, припѣвая къ 3-ому стиху „Слава“, а къ 4-му „И нынѣ“. Подъ пѣніемъ 3-го и 4-го стиха, т. е. на „Слава и Нынѣ“ Іерей облекается въ фелонъ, восходитъ къ св. Трапезѣ, возглашаетъ: „Вонмимъ, миръ всѣмъ, премуд- рость вонмимъ“. Таже ликъ поетъ прокименъ дневный. По про- кименѣ дневный. По прокименѣ Іерей растворяетъ царскія двери, глаголюще: „Господу помолимся“. units.slavonic_text: *) Въ Субботу Лазареву на Утрени (Утреня съ Славословіемъ) поются тропари: Ангелскій Соборъ, ект. малая и Іерей предъ царскими враты глаголетъ: „Воскресеніе Христово“ разъ, и такъ чтется пс. 50. По канонѣ же ект. малая и „Святъ Господь“ 3-ды. **) Передъ каѳизмою и по каѳизмѣ все такъ глаголется якъ сказанно было выше.
units.english_text: (β) Matins with the Polyeleos, with the Gospel, and with the Great Doxology. It is celebrated on weekdays if there occur a Saint having a polyeleos, or a feast of the Lord, or a feast of the Mother of God. The order of this Matins is as followeth: The Priest, having put on the epitrachelion, cometh before the royal doors, and having made a bow there, saith: “Blessed is our God.” The choir: “Amen.” Then (if there was no Midnight Office): “O Heavenly King.” After this also the rest of the usual beginning. After “Come, let us worship” (thrice), Psalms: 19 and the 20th [Pss. 19, 20]. And immediately The Trisagion. “Our Father” with the exclamation. After this the troparia are read: “Save, O God, Thy people,” etc., after which the litany for the Emperor with the exclamation. Unto the exclamation the choir answereth: “Amen,” and immediately proclaimeth: “In the name of the Lord bless, Father.” Unto this the Priest: “Glory to the holy...” etc. The choir: “Amen,” and immediately: “Glory to God in the highest,” etc. (thrice), “O Lord, open Thou my lips,” etc. (twice). And there followeth the Six Psalms. (The Priest entereth into the holy sanctuary and reciteth the priestly morning prayers.) After the Six Psalms the Priest cometh forth and the litany of peace is chanted. “God is the Lord, and hath appeared unto us,” etc. (4 times). Festal troparia. Kathisma 1. The 1st Sessional Hymn of the Saint. Kathisma 2. The 2nd Sessional Hymn of the Saint.[^123] After this: “Glory,” and “Now and,” Theotokion, and instead of the 3rd kathisma the choir singeth the Polyeleos (that is to say, verses from the 19th Kathisma: “Praise the name of the Lord,” etc.). After this: The Megalynarion with the verses. After this the small litany is said and the choir singeth the 3rd Sessional Hymn (the polyeleos one), “Glory,” and “Now and,” Theotokion. Then the Gradual Hymns of the 4th Tone, the 1st Antiphon: “From my youth,” which are sung to 4 verses, chanting unto the 3rd verse “Glory,” and unto the 4th “Now and.” During the singing of the 3rd and 4th verses, that is to say, at “Glory,” and “Now and,” the Priest vesteth in the phelonion, ascendeth unto the Holy Table, and proclaimeth: “Let us attend! Peace be to all! Wisdom, let us attend!” Then the choir singeth the daily Prokimenon. After the Prokimenon the Priest openeth the royal doors, saying: “Let us pray to the Lord.” Unto this the choir: “Lord, have mercy,” and immediately the Priest saith the exclamation: “For holy art Thou,” etc. The choir: “Amen.” And again the Priest: “Let every breath praise the Lord,” and censeth the Holy Table and from the royal doors the people. After the choir singeth: “Let every breath praise the Lord” twice, the Priest [saith]: “That we may be accounted worthy to hear the holy Gospel,” etc. Then upon the choir’s response the Priest [saith]: “Peace be to all!” The choir: (“And to thy spirit”). And thereafter: “Wisdom, let us attend, let us hear the holy Gospel,” etc., and he readeth the holy Gospel, and that standing before the Holy Table. After the Gospel hath been read, immediately Psalm 50 [Ps. 50]. (The Priest, after reading the holy Gospel, goeth forth and giveth the holy Gospel to be kissed upon the ambo.) — After Psalm 50: “Glory”: “Through the prayers of the holy Archangel [or: holy Apostle, or: Prophet],” etc. ([Name]), in whose honor the service is celebrated. At “Now and”: “Through the prayers of the Most Holy Theotokos,” etc., is sung. At the end the refrain: “Have mercy on me, O God,” etc., and the sticheron of the Saint.[^124] After this the Priest, having returned unto the Holy Table, chanteth the litany: “Save, O God, Thy people,” etc., whereunto the choir [respondeth]: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice). And immediately the Priest: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice), whereunto the choir again: “Lord, have mercy” (thrice). And immediately the Priest [saith] the exclamation: “Through the mercy and compassions...”[^125] etc. After this exclamation the Priest shutteth the royal doors, divesteth of the phelonion, and the chanter beginneth to sing the canon on 14. In the canon all things are taken in order. Before the Katavasia of the 8th ode the choir proclaimeth the refrain: “We praise, we bless, we worship,” etc., and singeth the Katavasia. After the Katavasia the Priest proclaimeth: “The Theotokos and Mother of Light,” etc., and the magnification of the feast is sung (that is, the Heirmos of the 9th ode with the refrain) or “More honorable than the Cherubim.”[^126] After the 9th ode: the small litany and the Exaposteilarion. Stichera at the Praises (*Ainoi*): and that we set 4; “Glory,” of the Saint; “Now and,” Theotokion. At this the Priest vesteth in the phelonion, openeth the royal doors, and goeth forth onto the ambo, and proclaimeth: “Glory to God, Who hath shown us the light”; they sing the Great Doxology. The Trisagion. The troparion of the Saint and Theotokion. The Priest, having entered into the sanctuary, saith before the Holy Table the litanies: “Have mercy on us, O God,” and “Let us complete.” The great dismissal, the blessing, and he shutteth the royal doors.
